turns.text: Hello. The limited print arrived creased. I want a reprint, not my money back.
Hello, and I'm sorry the print arrived creased. To file a damage claim for a reprint, I need your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address the order was placed with.
Order SC-5221, email valeska.taranu@example.com. Delivery was within the last two weeks.

Thank you, Valeska. I have filed a damage claim (R-1) for order SC-5221, the limited print "Aurora de iarnă" (50x70 cm), asking for a reprint because it arrived creased. Staff must approve it. They will ask you for a photo of the damage and make the final decision. I'll note that you want a reprint, not a refund.

change.description: The limited print 'Aurora de iarnă' (50x70 cm) arrived creased.

turns.text: Please file the damage claim with a reprint. I can send a photo to the team.

The damage claim is already filed as R-1 for order SC-5221, with a reprint requested, so I have not filed it again. It is waiting for staff approval. Staff will ask you for a photo of the creased print, so please keep it ready. I can't send photos through this chat, so the team will tell you how to send it.
One side question: are limited drops ever restocked? Answer that, then I will come back to the claim.

No. Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved. Your claim R-1 is still pending, and you can come back to it any time.

turns.text: I have changed my mind. I want a full refund for the damaged print. If the claim is already on file for a reprint, please change its remedy to a refund.

I can't change claim R-1 to a refund myself. Refunds above 1000 lei are decided by a person. Your order total is 1320 lei, so I have passed your request to a colleague with the details of claim R-1. They will decide the remedy and ask you for a photo of the creased print. A colleague will take over from here.
